items.text: When workers exercise their right to strike, their health care must be protected. Last week, I introduced the Striking Workers Healthcare Protection Act with @RepCindyAxne to safeguard striking workers' health benefits from employer retaliation. https://t.co/sVoKgPtkHj https://t.co/AQALo9c8vn
and P.S. - Election Day should be a holiday. While we fight to get there, we must do everything in our power to help ALL workers exercise their sacred right to vote.

ALSO TODAY, I will vote for legislation that will give low-income families more access to infant formula. Families who depend on the Women, Infants and Children (WIC) nutrition program need access to safe, reliable infant formula, and we need to make sure it's available.

🧵(3/3)

After developing symptoms, I isolated and tested positive for COVID-19 from an at-home test on Wednesday. My office is still open and serving the people of the Fighting Fifth so catch up on Team Nikema's work with #NikemasNotes https://t.co/M6rWB9YedE

There's no point like East Point! I'm always fighting for the Fighting Fifth, so I brought @DeanaIngraham a $1.6 MILLION check that I secured for East Point's water treatment facility. This is a big deal y'all!

📷 @PastorTroyDSGB, @BigBoi, @DJGregStreet and Team Nikema https://t.co/7ma2Put612

This is about care and this is about love. Every dollar that goes to treatment, research and care for children battling cancer is lifechanging and lifesaving for young children AND their families. #EndChildhoodCancer

The Fighting Fifth has a proud history of fighting for justice and opportunity. The DeKalb County Accountability Courts live out that legacy by offering real treatment programs and real second chances. Congratulations Chief Judge Asha Jackson on today's ribbon-cutting! https://t.co/g3lGxauJLl

All of my love and well-wishes to Miss Omilami ❤️ Hosea Helps has been changing lives in our community for half a century, and I know nothing would dull Miss Omilami's spirit.

https://t.co/iIzmyYV6tQ

Everyone deserves access to birth control. I've used contraception as a treatment for #endometriosis and millions of other people use it every day for their health and wellbeing. I'll stand up to anyone who wants to tear that right away. #ThxBirthControl

During #AmeriCorpsWeek, I'm not just thanking AmeriCorps – I'm bringing home $600,000 in AmericaCorps VISTA grants to help everyone in our community! These grants work y'all – I'm ready to see the change that the Center for Black Women's Wellness and our other recipients create. https://t.co/TRePvEcGk2

Many full time students go hungry, so I introduced the Overcoming Higher Education Hunger Through the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (OHH SNAP) Act with @RepJahanaHayes to allow for low-income students or students with an EFC of $0 to participate in SNAP. https://t.co/BGzhwUBTVZ

All workers deserve a livable wage and a union that will fight for them. I’m proud to stand with a new generation of workers as they exercise their collective strength and make their voices heard. #LaborDay (1/2)

Today is #WorldContraceptionDay! Last year the house passed the Right to Contraception Act because access to contraception is key to reproductive freedom. I've used contraception as treatment for #endometriosis and millions of other people use it for their health and well being. https://t.co/iEVxFyn24s

Don’t forget to #FallBack! 

⏰ Set your clocks back one hour
🔋 Check the batteries in Smoke and Carbon Monoxide Detectors
😴 Enjoy your extra hour of sleep (or Saturday night fun! 🥳)

We are now 4 days away from a Republican-driven government shutdown. A shutdown would cause over 10,000 children in my district to lose access to critical nutrition assistance. 

While Republicans waste time, I stand ready to keep the government open and put #PeopleOverPolitics. https://t.co/krXjq0TgOI

I know the importance of chemotherapy in cancer treatment. That's why I signed onto @SenOssoff's letter requesting specific information about what the FDA is doing to reduce the shortage and how they are evaluating the safety of any imported chemotherapy drugs.

While it includes positive elements like the John Lewis Civil Rights Fellowship Act, I cannot support a bill that perpetuates excessive defense spending at the expense of crucial investments in affordable housing, education, and nutrition assistance programs.

Full statement ⬇️ https://t.co/NeSB6lddd0

As a former educator I know hungry students can't learn. So, it was great to have @SecretaryVilsack back in the #FightingFifth for a vital conversation on child nutrition. I'm grateful to collaborate with the Biden-Harris administration to invest in ending hunger. https://t.co/FBwrYkoynC

After my mama’s cancer diagnosis, I took personal time off to take care of her in her final days. Let this #NationalCaregiversDay serve as a reminder that we must do all we can to ease the burden of caregiving in this country because #CareCantWait. https://t.co/J4HVyaym7C

Kay defined the phrase “women helping women” as she dedicated her life to defending reproductive freedom from the treatment room to under the Gold dome. 

Kay will be forever missed. I love you, and I hope to keep making you proud. (2/2)

Colorectal cancer is one of the most preventable forms of cancer with proper screening. This #ColorectalCancerAwarenessMonth I met with @FightCRC and Colon Cancer survivors on prevention and treatment. Because less cancer equals more birthdays. https://t.co/cvYw5CUiis

Black Americans make up 41% of new HIV infections, yet only 13% of Black and 24% of Hispanic people who could benefit have been prescribed PrEP, compared to 94% of white people. This is unacceptable!
https://t.co/jqr99wTzY7

80% of Black women will develop uterine fibroids, and they’re more likely to experience SEVERE symptoms. I’m proud to cosponsor @RepShontelBrown’s #UFIGHT Act, which authorizes federal grants for detection, treatment and research.

I was diagnosed with #Endometriosis at 14. Like many that suffer from endometriosis it took several different doctors to get a diagnosis and that’s due to a lack of research. The #EndoCAREAct would invest $50 million in Endometriosis research through the @NIH. https://t.co/bhO4lHNtJd
